label: Overseas financial account reporting: the combined balance that triggers it
unit: KRW, combined across all qualifying accounts
appliesTo: Korean tax residents and domestic corporations holding qualifying overseas financial accounts
why: Quoted wrong in two directions. It is combined across every qualifying account, not per account, so three mid-sized accounts can cross it while none does alone. And it is tested at each of the twelve month-ends, not at 31 December, so a balance that peaked in March and fell back can still create a June filing obligation. The statute requires the combined figure to exceed the amount, so exactly ₩500 million does not qualify.

history.source: Adjustment of International Taxes Act, art. 53 and Enforcement Decree art. 92
history.note: A reporting obligation can arise where the combined prescribed balances of qualifying overseas financial accounts exceed ₩500 million at any month-end in the reporting year, with the highest combined month-end as the reporting reference date. Filing runs 1-30 June of the following year. A qualifying foreign resident with five years or less of cumulative Korean domicile or residence in the preceding ten years may be exempt under art. 54.
